title: Yara and the Vector
author: Bram Quintana
blurb: Isandro Thornbury, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
